pictures.name: clay_shaped_on_the_wheel
pictures.scene: a tall clay vessel rising smooth and even on a turning wheel with wet clay bright on its sides, the wheel and the vessel lit warm and gold at the bottom of the frame, the workshop above it brown and dim

pictures.name: mist_clearing_from_a_valley_floor
pictures.scene: low mist thinning and lifting off a valley floor so that the fields below come clear, the near grass lit warm and bright at the bottom of the frame, the pale air and slopes above it soft and quiet

pictures.name: bright_window_seen_from_the_track
pictures.scene: one warmly lit window seen from a dark track some way off across open ground, the near path lit faintly at the bottom of the frame, the night country and sky above it deep and blue and still

pictures.name: metal_worked_hot_on_the_anvil
pictures.scene: a bar of iron glowing orange on a heavy anvil with sparks scattered around it, the hot metal lit brilliant and warm at the bottom of the frame, the dark forge above and behind it deep and dim

pictures.name: warm_cloak_spread_over_a_bench
pictures.scene: a thick woollen cloak laid out carefully over a low stone bench in a cold room, the cloak lit warm and soft at the bottom of the frame, the bare wall above it dim and grey and quiet

pictures.name: water_reaching_a_wilted_plant
pictures.scene: clear water running along a furrow and just reaching the roots of a drooping plant, the wet soil and the water lit warm and bright at the bottom of the frame, the leaves above them dim and still

pictures.name: garden_pool_with_lilies_open
pictures.scene: a small walled garden pool with water lilies fully open across its surface, the nearest flowers lit warm and bright at the bottom of the frame, the still water and wall above them soft and dim

pictures.name: crooked_wall_leaning_and_cracked
pictures.scene: a badly built wall leaning well out of true with a long crack running down it, the near stones lit hard and warm at the bottom of the frame, the leaning courses above them dim and uneven and failing

pictures.name: several_paths_bending_toward_one_fire
pictures.scene: three faint tracks across dark open ground all bending in toward one small fire, the fire and near grass lit warm and gold at the bottom of the frame, the night country above them deep and blue

pictures.name: clear_water_in_a_clean_stone_basin
pictures.scene: a shallow stone basin holding water so clear that every grain of the stone shows through it, the basin lit warm and bright at the bottom of the frame, the wall above it plain and pale and quiet

pictures.name: whitewashed_wall_in_full_sun
pictures.scene: a broad whitewashed wall standing clean and bright in full sunlight, the base of it lit warm and gold along the bottom of the frame, the pale surface rising above it even and open and unmarked

lines.text: Your hands have made me and fashioned me;
give me understanding to learn Your commandments.
May those who fear You see me and rejoice,
for I have hoped in Your word.
I know, O LORD, that Your judgments are righteous,
and that in faithfulness You have afflicted me.
May Your loving devotion comfort me, I pray,
according to Your promise to Your servant.
May Your compassion come to me, that I may live,
for Your law is my delight.
May the arrogant be put to shame for subverting me with a lie;
I will meditate on Your precepts.
May those who fear You turn to me,
May my heart be blameless in Your statutes,
that I may not be put to shame.
